# pkg6/cache

> 标签: cache, cache-file, cache-memcache, cache-memcached, cache-redis, cache-wincache, easy-cache, think-cache

## 简介

A cache that is more comfortable to use for Chinese people

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 7；已收录于 php-v7, php-v8。
